ios.desc:
Track your work hours in one tap, see what you earned, and send clients a clean PDF report. Timemator is a simple time tracker for freelancers and anyone who bills by the hour. Pay once. No subscription.

ONE-TAP TIME TRACKING
• Start and stop timers for tasks and projects with a single tap
• Organize tasks into folders by client or project, with colors
• Add notes to sessions so you remember what you worked on
• Keep an eye on the running timer in Live Activities and the Dynamic Island

HOURS AND EARNINGS AT A GLANCE
• Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly reports with clear charts
• Set hourly rates and see your revenue calculated automatically
• Breakdown by task and folder, plus your average hours per day

CLIENT-READY REPORTS
• Export professional PDF reports with time and revenue totals
• Export CSV for spreadsheets, invoicing and accounting tools

TIMELINE
• See every work session of your day on a timeline
• Add time you forgot to track, or fix a session in seconds

WORKS WHERE YOU WORK
• Home Screen widgets for timers, hours and revenue
• Apple Watch app to start and stop timers from your wrist
• Shortcuts: create a task and start its timer hands-free
• Runs on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch

PAIRS WITH TIMEMATOR FOR MAC
Sync everything through iCloud with Timemator for Mac, which can track your time automatically based on the files, websites and apps you work with. The Mac app is sold separately.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No data collected: no analytics, no tracking
• No account or sign-up needed
• Works offline
• Your data stays on your devices and syncs through your own iCloud

SIMPLE PRICING
Try every feature free for 30 days. Then unlock Timemator with a single one-time purchase. No subscription.

Questions or ideas? Write to support@timemator.com. We read every message.

quotes.text:
A couple of small and simple iOS apps after being frustrated with more enterprise based solutions.

Thiro [https://apps.apple.com/us/app/thiro/id1555982483] a basic time tracker that does grouping and reports right. The only thing it lacks is billable hours.

Emerald
[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/emerald-money-journal/id1437054263]
A super simple expense tracker that does most things right, but unfortunately has a few bugs. It’s the only one I could find available that is privacy friendly and doesn’t have bloat.

Both of those apps are made by indie devs and have no subscriptions.

In addition, I am trying out timeator[https://apps.apple.com/us/app/timemator-time-tracking/id1458451587]
which has the right idea for how I want revenue and time tracking to be integrated.
